offlineBanner: You are offline. Unsynced attendance and cached pages may be all you have until the network returns.
installTitle: Don't lose a school day to bad connectivity
installDescription: Install ShuleOS on this device—one tap now beats re-entering attendance when the network drops.
installAppDescription: Add ShuleOS to your home screen before the next time the connection fails.
offlineDescription: {productName} needs a connection for most features. Cached pages may still open, and attendance you saved offline will sync when you reconnect.
pushPromptTitle: Missed periods cost the whole class
pushPromptDescription: Turn on alerts so the next period hits your lock screen like an alarm—before students are waiting and you're still in the hallway.
updateDescription: Update once to load the latest build. This prompt only comes back when another version actually ships.
tapShareThenAdd: Tap Share, then choose Add to Home Screen.
iosInstallHint: Add to your home screen for quick access. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
androidInstallHint: Install the app on this device for faster access, full-screen mode, and offline support.
shareThenAddToHomeScreen: Share, then Add to Home Screen

iosGuide.title: Add {productName} to your home screen
iosGuide.subtitle: Buried in Safari, the next absence alert is a tab you already closed. Pin it once — about ten seconds — before the next roll call.
iosGuide.step1TitleTop: Tap the share icon in the toolbar
iosGuide.step2Title: Tap “Add to Home Screen” in the pop-up
iosGuide.step3Hint: Then tap Add — {productName} lands next to your other apps.
iosGuide.inAppTitle: Open this page in Safari first
iosGuide.inAppBody: In-app browsers can’t pin {productName} to your home screen. Tap the menu, choose Open in Safari, then follow these steps — or the icon never lands.
